finding_disposition.classification: SHOWN exact archived-to-current source delta and independently passing synthetic regressions
finding_disposition.assessment: The incumbent now validates every present current frame open/close against a complete/available one-hour panel window before its weekly early return. Contradictory Monday opens/closes and a missing current panel hour can no longer produce a COMPLETE valid return path. The existing Sunday trigger, permission/history validation and weekly target formula remain byte-identical after the new prelude. Missing raw prices are not invented from the panel.
finding_disposition.causal_boundary: Validation runs through the completed-bar callback. It does not inspect a future close to cancel an earlier modeled opening fill. A failed bar may leave diagnostic trades/equity entries in retained state, but status is INCOMPLETE, marked_nav/net_profit are None and state.valid is False; this is not a valid performance account or accepted execution record.
finding_disposition.closure_proof: Three new parametrized cases begin with a genuine synthetic Sunday target and verify an actual Monday opening fill in the valid baseline. Open contradiction, close contradiction and missing current-panel hour each produce INCOMPLETE/unknown NAV and profit/invalid state after correction. Existing incumbent formula/UTC cadence and unchanged-source regression cases also pass.

retained_risks: This closes the named frame-consistency defect for the bound correction. It is not a fresh exhaustive review of every bridge or ledger behavior.

Validation at completed-bar time may retain diagnostic fills or equity entries for the invalid bar. Consumers must honor INCOMPLETE, None NAV/profit and invalid state rather than extract those entries as valid realized returns.
The correction intentionally does not use future close information to pre-cancel an opening fill and does not add off-schedule incumbent rebalancing.
If neither raw open nor close is present, the prelude does not invent one. Existing ledger valuation/missing-execution semantics and Sunday required-history rules remain applicable.
Strategy/panel inputs are caller supplied; source/configuration identity and synthetic fixtures are not historical market data or actual venue/tradability proof.
One venue/common quote/no yield or FX, and MODELLED full fills with declared costs/dated eligibility, remain the two explicit modelling assumptions.

The wider cost/horizon/inference proposal, calibration, market-data feasibility, prospective freeze/activation, economics and production integration remain unapproved or unverified outside this review.
